startingCard.title: Alexander the Great becomes king of Macedonia
startingCard.fact: Alexander III of Macedon, most commonly known as Alexander the Great, was king of the ancient Greek kingdom of Macedon.

cards.title: ‘Zorba the Greek’ is released
cards.subtitle: Film directed by Michalis Cacoyannis
cards.fact: Zorba the Greek is a 1964 drama film written, produced, edited, and directed by Greek Cypriot filmmaker Michael Cacoyannis.

cards.title: ‘Tokyo Revengers’ begins
cards.subtitle: Japanese manga series
cards.fact: Tokyo Revengers is a Japanese manga series written and illustrated by Ken Wakui.

cards.title: Lebanese Civil War begins
cards.subtitle: Conflict
cards.fact: The Lebanese Civil War was a multifaceted armed conflict that took place from 1975 to 1990.

cards.title: Sukhoi Su-57 first flies
cards.subtitle: Aircraft by Komsomolsk-on-Amur Aircraft Production Association
cards.fact: The Sukhoi Su-57 is a twin-engine stealth multirole fighter aircraft developed by Sukhoi.

cards.title: ‘The Passion of the Christ’ is released
cards.subtitle: Film directed by Mel Gibson
cards.fact: The Passion of the Christ is a 2004 American epic biblical drama film co-produced and directed by Mel Gibson from a screenplay he wrote with Benedict Fitzgerald.

cards.title: Samsung Galaxy Note II debuts
cards.subtitle: Cell Phone
cards.fact: The Samsung Galaxy Note II is an Android phablet smartphone developed, marketed and manufactured by Samsung Electronics.

cards.title: Modena Cathedral is completed
cards.subtitle: Cathedral of Modena, Emilia-Romagna, Italy
cards.fact: Modena Cathedral is a Roman Catholic cathedral in Modena, Italy, dedicated to the Assumption of the Virgin Mary and Saint Geminianus.

cards.title: Avicii dies
cards.subtitle: Swedish record producer
cards.fact: Tim Bergling, known professionally as Avicii, was a Swedish DJ, remixer, and record producer.

cards.title: Mozambican War of Independence begins
cards.subtitle: Conflict
cards.fact: The Mozambican War of Independence was an armed conflict between the guerrilla forces of the Mozambique Liberation Front (FRELIMO) and Portugal.

cards.title: ‘One Flew Over the Cuckoo's Nest’ is released
cards.subtitle: Film directed by Miloš Forman
cards.fact: One Flew Over the Cuckoo's Nest is a 1975 American psychological comedy-drama film directed by Miloš Forman, based on the 1962 novel of the same name by Ken Kesey.

cards.title: ‘Impression, Sunrise’ is painted
cards.subtitle: Painting by Claude Monet
cards.fact: Impression, Sunrise is an 1872 painting by Claude Monet first shown at what would become known as the "Exhibition of the Impressionists" in Paris in April, 1874.

cards.title: ‘The Mysterious Affair at Styles’ is published
cards.subtitle: Book by Agatha Christie
cards.fact: The Mysterious Affair at Styles is the first mystery novel by British writer Agatha Christie, introducing her fictional detective Hercule Poirot.

cards.title: ‘The Usual Suspects’ is released
cards.subtitle: Film directed by Bryan Singer
cards.fact: The Usual Suspects is a 1995 crime thriller film directed by Bryan Singer and written by Christopher McQuarrie.

cards.title: ‘Mulholland Drive’ is released
cards.subtitle: Film directed by David Lynch
cards.fact: Mulholland Drive is a 2001 mystery film written and directed by David Lynch.

cards.title: Giotto's Campanile is completed
cards.subtitle: Bell tower by Giotto
cards.fact: Giotto's Campanile is a free-standing campanile that is part of the complex of buildings that make up Florence Cathedral on the Piazza del Duomo in Florence, Italy.

cards.title: Senusret II becomes pharaoh
cards.fact: Senusret II or Sesostris II was the fourth king of the 12th Dynasty of Egypt.

cards.title: Gemini 7 launches
cards.subtitle: Mission by National Aeronautics and Space Administration
cards.fact: Gemini 7 was a 1965 crewed spaceflight in NASA's Gemini program.

cards.title: Neferirkare Kakai becomes pharaoh
cards.fact: Neferirkare Kakai was an ancient Egyptian pharaoh, the third king of the Fifth Dynasty.

cards.title: Henry II of France becomes king of France
cards.fact: Henry II was King of France from 1547 until his death in 1559.

cards.title: ‘Superunknown’ is released
cards.subtitle: Album by Soundgarden
cards.fact: Superunknown is the fourth studio album by American rock band Soundgarden, released on March 8, 1994, through A&M Records.

cards.title: ‘Kirby's Dream Land 2’ releases
cards.subtitle: Video game by HAL Laboratory
cards.fact: Kirby's Dream Land 2 is a 1995 platform game developed by HAL Laboratory and published by Nintendo for the Game Boy handheld video game console.

cards.title: Peter Abelard dies
cards.subtitle: French scholastic philosopher, theologian and preeminent logician
cards.fact: Peter Abelard was a medieval French scholastic, philosopher, leading logician, theologian, teacher, musician, composer, and poet.

cards.title: Edward Heath becomes prime minister of the United Kingdom
cards.fact: Sir Edward Richard George Heath was a British politician who served as Prime Minister of the United Kingdom from 1970 to 1974 and Leader of the Conservative Party from 1965 to 1975.

cards.title: Greece–Bosnia and Herzegovina Friendship Building is completed
cards.subtitle: Office building in Sarajevo, Bosnia and Herzegovina
cards.fact: The Greece–Bosnia and Herzegovina Friendship Building is a government office building in Sarajevo, Bosnia and Herzegovina.

cards.title: Saladin becomes Ayyubid sultan
cards.fact: Salah ad-Din Yusuf ibn Ayyub, commonly known as Saladin, was a Kurdish commander and political leader.

cards.title: Raspberry Pi OS is released
cards.subtitle: Operating System
cards.fact: Raspberry Pi OS is a Unix-like operating system developed for the Raspberry Pi line of single-board computers.

cards.title: Umayyad Caliphate is established
cards.subtitle: Historical state
cards.fact: The Umayyad Caliphate or the Umayyad Empire was the second caliphate established after the death of the Islamic prophet Muhammad and was ruled by the Umayyad dynasty from 661 to 750.

cards.title: Carrie Fisher dies
cards.subtitle: American actress, writer and screenwriter
cards.fact: Carrie Frances Fisher was an American actress and writer.

cards.title: Prussian Crusade begins
cards.subtitle: Conflict
cards.fact: The Prussian Crusade was a series of 13th-century campaigns of Roman Catholic crusaders, primarily led by the Teutonic Knights, to Christianize under duress the pagan Old Prussians.

cards.title: French Third Republic is established
cards.subtitle: Historical state
cards.fact: The French Third Republic was the system of government adopted in France from 4 September 1870, when the Second French Empire collapsed during the Franco-Prussian War, until 10 July 1940, after the Fall of France during World War II led to the formation of the Vichy government.
